title: Planned maintenance: nbn services connected via the Blacktown (NSW) POI
current_summary: Planned network migration and optimisation work by a network provider affecting the Blacktown (NSW) nbn Point of Interconnect began at 12:00am AEDT on Thursday 26 November 2026. The work is scheduled to run until 3:00am AEDT. nbn services connected through this location may be affected for up to 3 hours during this window.

cause.reason: Planned network migration and optimisation work by a network provider.

updates.content: We have been advised of planned maintenance by a network provider. They will be carrying out network migration and optimisation work affecting the nbn Point of Interconnect in Blacktown, NSW. The work is scheduled between 12:00am and 3:00am AEDT on Thursday 26 November 2026. During this window, nbn services connected through this location may be affected for up to 3 hours. We will share any further updates as we receive them.

The planned maintenance affecting the Blacktown (NSW) nbn Point of Interconnect has started, as of 12:00am AEDT on Thursday 26 November 2026. The work is scheduled to finish by 3:00am AEDT, and nbn services connected through this location may be affected for up to 3 hours during that window. We will share a further update when the work is complete.
